sources.title: MiMo-V2-Omni launch
sources.evidence: Original March 18, 2026 launch names Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Omni. Dedicated image/video/audio encoders feed a shared backbone; it reads text and returns demonstrated text and structured tool calls. OpenClaw executes filesystem, terminal and browser actions. No parameter counts or dense/MoE backbone classification.

sources.title: Model Release changelog
sources.evidence: March 18, 2026 entry explicitly releases mimo-v2-omni with 256K context and text, vision and speech modalities. Adjacent Pro/Flash architecture and parameter figures belong to different models.

sources.title: MiMo-V2-Omni release announcement in API documentation
sources.evidence: Announces public API service for exact Omni, native multimodal perception and agent/tool use. The current June 29 update stamp is not the original release date.

sources.title: Model Deprecation
sources.evidence: Defines system replacement as rerouting to a newer model and deprecation as expiry of the old identifier. Omni was routed to V2.5 on June 1, 2026 and retired June 30, both at 00:00 UTC+8. Therefore later replacement specs do not describe original Omni.

sources.title: XiaomiMiMo public model inventory
sources.evidence: Read all 30 returned public model entries, including Flash, V2.5 and V2.6 releases; no exact V2-Omni checkpoint, config or weight license was listed. This is corroboration of hosted distribution, not a complete proof of nonexistence.

sources.title: Xiaomi MiMo Service Agreement
sources.evidence: Read the actual English/Chinese agreement in its public document chunk linked from the site runtime (s7); direct page HTML is a client shell. July 7, 2026 version covers hosted API service; section 5.1 reserves MiMo model parameters, algorithms, code and architecture rights to Xiaomi.

sources.title: Service Agreement public document content
sources.evidence: Exact document-content chunk mapped to quick-start/terms/user-agreement by the official site. English section 5.1 retains model ownership/IP; section 3 defines restricted service use. Supports descriptive proprietary classification, not an open checkpoint license.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5 model card
sources.evidence: Later official card gives V2.5 its own nominal 310B/15B MoE specification and component description. It does not identify these as V2-Omni figures. Its weights/license cannot be transferred across the documented API replacement.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
sources.evidence: Read introduction/architecture and searched complete extracted report for Omni. Its Transformer, hybrid SWA/global attention and MoE topology describe V2.6; no exact V2-Omni total/active count or topology disclosure was found.

sources.title: MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training
sources.evidence: Read abstract/introduction and searched full text for Omni. This later training research discusses Qwen3-30B-A3B and deployment on MiMo-V2-Flash, not exact V2-Omni; it does not resolve Omni parameter count or topology.

sources.title: OpenClaw v2026.3.23 native Xiaomi provider catalog
sources.evidence: Contemporaneous integration code explicitly configures mimo-v2-omni with reasoning:true and contextWindow:262144 at https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1. This March version predates June rerouting. It is primary evidence of the integration behavior, not Xiaomi parameter/topology disclosure.

sources.title: MiMo-V2-Omni historical provider record
sources.evidence: Complete indexed exact-model page states March 18 release, 262144-token context and text/audio/image/video input to text output. Direct fetch returned 403 and browser extraction only shell; indexed provider documentation is used for last-documented specifications, not current operation.

sources.title: MiMo-V2-Omni endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct JSON retains exact model identity, text+image+audio+video to text modalities, and an empty endpoints array. The public models listing also omits this identifier. This does not establish a currently usable Omni endpoint.

sources.title: MiMo Studio changelog
sources.evidence: March 19, 2026 Studio update adds an Omni experience and multimodal file upload. Platform file handling is distinct from the native input encoders documented at launch; it does not establish PDF as a native model modality.

developer.note: Developer attribution on the original launch and official changelog.

family.note: Normalized family key for the named MiMo series.

release_date.note: Original public API launch date; March 19 is Studio integration and June 29 is a later documentation update.

open_weights.note: Released as hosted API service; no exact Omni public checkpoint/config/weight license found in the official model inventory. Open sibling checkpoints are separate releases.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted model under Xiaomi service terms, not a named downloadable-weight license. Current terms were updated after the original API release.

parameters_b.note: No exact Omni total count disclosed in the accessed original announcement or later official model/training materials. V2-Flash 309B, V2.5 310B and Pro 1T are not Omni evidence. No exact checkpoint was available to inspect.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact Omni active count or expert routing configuration disclosed. Sibling 15B/42B figures cannot be transferred; no numerical count is inferred.

architecture.note: Dedicated modality encoders and a shared backbone are documented, but its Transformer/dense/MoE network class and detailed topology remain unspecified in accessed exact-model evidence. Later siblings do not establish this class.

context_window.note: Xiaomi calls original context 256K; contemporaneous native-Xiaomi OpenClaw integration and exact OpenRouter provider record specify 262144 tokens. This records the original documented interface, not a test of the retired endpoint or replacement model.

modalities.note: Native modalities supported by launch and exact provider metadata. Remove PDF: upload/tool workflows do not establish a native PDF encoder. Tool-generated audio/video demos do not establish native media output.

reasoning.note: Original OpenClaw v2026.3.23 native-Xiaomi integration explicitly enables reasoning for this exact identifier, before replacement. Launch describes multimodal reasoning. This is documented historical interface capability, not a current endpoint test.

tool_call.note: Launch explicitly documents native structured tool calling; execution of external actions belongs to the agent scaffold.

description.value: Multimodal model with text, image, audio and video input, text output, and structured tool calling.
description.note: Neutral capability summary restricted to native model inputs, text output and tool-call generation.

sources.label: OpenClaw v2026.3.23 native Xiaomi provider catalog

patch.notes: Original MiMo-V2-Omni was released March 18, 2026. Xiaomi states 256K context; contemporaneous native-Xiaomi integration and OpenRouter document 262144 tokens. Reasoning is documented by the March 23 OpenClaw native integration. Total/active parameters and neural backbone class remain undisclosed; dedicated image/video/audio encoders share one backbone. Native inputs exclude PDF; external tools produce any media in agent demos. Xiaomi routed this identifier to V2.5 on June 1, 2026 and retired it June 30 (00:00 UTC+8); original specifications are retained, not replacement specifications.

summary: Audited all fourteen fields for original Omni. Confirmed March 18 release and original 262144 context, reasoning and structured tool calling using launch and contemporaneous integration evidence. Added proprietary classification, removed unsupported native PDF, and replaced generic description. Total/active counts and network class remain undisclosed after later primary-card/training-report checks. Recorded June rerouting/retirement so V2.5/V2.6 specifications are not transferred.
